author: reek
body: Federated fact synchronization between agent workspaces. When an agent creates annotations, proposals, or verdicts, FactSync pushes them to peers via TrustTransport. When facts arrive from peers, FactSync deduplicates by content hash and persists to the local DiskFacts.

author: reek
body: The sync model is push-pull: each agent pushes its new facts to known peers, and can request missing facts by hash. Content addressing makes dedup automatic -- identical content produces identical hashes, so duplicate delivery is a no-op.

author: reek
body: Push all locally-persisted annotations to a connected peer. Each annotation is wrapped in an AnnotateMsg envelope via AnnotationTransport's sign-annotate-envelope, then sent over the TrustSession. Returns the updated session and send count.

author: reek
body: Process an incoming AgentMessage from a peer. Annotations are verified, deduplicated by hash, and persisted to DiskFacts. Verdicts are verified and persisted. Unknown message kinds are silently ignored.

author: reek
body: sync-push-all pushes annotations, proposals, and verdicts to a single peer. sync-pull-all receives messages until the peer has nothing more to send (indicated by a None from trust-recv).
